# CCBeep

CCBeep is a zero-dependency sound notification plugin for Claude Code.

## Summary

CCBeep plays audible alerts when Claude Code needs user approval or finishes a response. It is designed for developers running long Claude Code sessions who want to know when Claude needs attention without watching the terminal.

It hooks into Claude Code's native event system using the `PermissionRequest` and `Stop` hooks. Sound playback uses built-in OS tools — no external packages or background services required.

## Main use cases

- Get a sound alert when Claude Code presents an interactive approval prompt
- Hear when Claude Code finishes a response or stops running
- Step away from the terminal without missing permission prompts
- Add cross-platform audio notifications to Claude Code hooks with no extra dependencies

## Key features

- PermissionRequest hook support — plays a sound for interactive approval prompts
- Stop hook support — plays a sound when the Claude Code agent stops
- Zero external dependencies — built-in OS audio tools only (afplay, paplay/aplay, PowerShell)
- Cross-platform: macOS, Linux, and Windows
- Custom sounds via ~/.ccbeep.json or --sound flag
- Mute and timed mute (mute.sh / unmute.sh)
- Install via script, Claude Code plugin, or manual hook configuration

## Keywords
